svg.title: When the release pull request merges
svg.desc: Where the variable RELEASE_MERGE is daily, as in the blueprint, the release bot merges every release by itself. The run of a merge into main only keeps the release pull request current, unless the merge fixes a vulnerability, which merges at once. The daily run at 02:25 UTC merges it once its checks pass, unless a release went out that day already. A run of Release that you start by hand releases at once, for a fix that can't wait. With maintainer, the default of a new repository, you merge it, and only a release of dependency updates merges itself, once a day. The Rollout then brings the release to every repository that follows the blueprint.
